name: PHP Clock
shortDescription: Provides current timestamp and date/time information with timezone support through a lightweight PHP-based server built with Symfony components, offering both STDIO and Server-Sent Events transport methods with JWT authentication and rate limiting.

rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A lightweight PHP-based MCP server built with Symfony that provides current timestamp and date/time information to AI assistants like Claude. Created using the Symfony MCP Bundle and Symfony Clock components, it offers both STDIO and Server-Sent Events transport methods for integration with various AI tools. The implementation includes JWT-based authentication, rate limiting, and timezone support, making it useful for applications that need reliable access to current time data without complex setup - particularly valuable for local development environments where feeding Claude with accurate timestamp information is needed.
